TRIAGE CANDIDATE (not a blocker): generalize the hook's guard onto engine_runtime_closure and make the resolver subdir-aware. This is the same item the Fowler pass flagged as duplicated-code.

triage_candidates.statement: Generalize the gauge_writer_hook companion guard onto engine_runtime_closure(). tests/test_install_constellation.py:1473 still uses the verbatim pre-#362 regex-only single-hop form, blind to sys.path.insert + plain import. Requires making module resolution SCRIPT_SOURCE_SUBDIRS-aware, since hooks live in scripts/hooks/ but could import from scripts/. Nothing is undeclared today (both hook files are stdlib-only), so this is prevention, not a fix.

Detector blind spots that are latent today: the path-load half still only matches a DOUBLE-quoted parent / "x.py" (single quotes, .joinpath(), and f-string paths all miss), and string-based dynamic imports (importlib.import_module / __import__) plus package-directory imports are invisible to the AST half. None is currently exercised in the engine's closure; worth either widening or documenting as an explicit non-goal so the next sidecar author knows the boundary.

LIVE-OBSERVED, from this review's own run: episode_capture.manifest_root() takes the checklist directory's PARENT, documenting the assumption that 'a run's checklist lives at <agent-work>/<work-id>/spine.json'. The constellation-reviewer skill (and this handoff) place the survey one level deeper, at .agent-work/<work-id>/<gate>-review/review.json. With work_id='issue-305' that resolves the root to .agent-work/issue-305 and writes every manifest to .agent-work/issue-305/issue-305/context/ - a DOUBLED work-id segment. Reproduced 15/15 steps this run. My control probe (checklist directly at .agent-work/issue-999/probe.json) landed correctly at .agent-work/issue-999/context/. Two skills disagree about the work-area layout; the seam silently produces a nested duplicate rather than failing. Not a defect in the diff under review (which is about SHIPPING the seam, and shipping works) - but it is a real defect in the seam's root resolution or in the reviewer skill's documented survey path, and it leaves confusing orphan directories for closeout.
